label: Frozen yoghurt
comment: The mix is fermented with the yoghurt culture, or yoghurt is blended in, then frozen like ice cream.
step: ferment or blend yoghurt in, freeze with air
note: Many shops sell frozen yoghurt made from a heat-treated yoghurt base, so it may no longer hold live cultures.

about.text: A frozen dessert made from yoghurt, sweetened and stabilised, then whipped and frozen like ice cream. Invented in New England, USA, in the 1970s.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The mix of milk, sugar and stabiliser (gelatin, guar gum or carrageenan, which hold back ice crystals) is homogenised, set with the yoghurt culture (or blended with yoghurt), chilled, aged and then frozen with air whipped in, like ice cream.

steps.note: Milk, sugar and a stabiliser (gelatin, guar gum or carrageenan) hold back ice crystals.

steps.name: freeze
steps.note: Air is whipped in while it freezes.

processing.text: Held until set. Some mixes blend finished yoghurt into the cold mix instead.
